svg.title: Invoices with no file
svg.text: Invoices with no file
A contractor emails or texts an amount with no PDF, or sends a 'View invoice' link from Square or Jobber.
A. They still land, and a file can be added later
Recommended
The email's text, links kept, sits where the file would. New invoice can be saved with no file. In To review, Add the invoice file sits under it.
Laptop 1280
An emailed invoice with no attachment

svg.text: B. A file is required
An emailed invoice with no attachment isn't saved, and New invoice can't be approved without a file.
Laptop 1280
An emailed invoice with no attachment

g.text: Dave's email had no file, so it wasn't saved.
It stays in your inbox as today.

g.text: Dave's email had no file, so it wasn't saved.
It stays in your inbox as today.

svg.text: Notes
A: a texted amount goes in through New invoice with no file; the PDF can be dropped on later while it's in To review.
A: the whole email text is kept (not cut at 'Forwarded message'), so a forward's invoice text and its links survive.
A: once approved, fields and files are read-only; Back to review reopens them, as for every invoice.
B: drawn as a description only; nothing appears in the app, since the email is dropped.
A reply on a done job with no file stays a plain forward to you and Pieter in both, as today.
